h1: Custom Screen Printing for Cups, Shot Glasses & Ice Buckets
lead: We screen print your logo, lettering and artwork on plastic cups, stadium cups, shot glasses and ice buckets for bars, events and brand promotions. Send your artwork or idea for a free design proposal and a product visual mockup.
html:
Questions Before You Order

What are your payment terms?

We require a 30% deposit. The remaining 70% must be paid in full before shipment.

Which payment methods do you accept?

We accept T/T (bank transfer), Western Union and Alipay.

Which currencies can I pay in?

We accept USD, CNY, EUR and GBP. Other currencies can also be arranged for your order.

Which trade terms do you offer?

We offer EXW (Ex Works), FOB Shenzhen, C&F and DDP. The trade term is agreed with you for each order.

Can I use the same logo on cups and ice buckets?

Yes. We screen print plastic cups, stadium cups, shot glasses and ice buckets. Send the product references together; our free design proposal shows the logo layout on each selected shape.

How do I specify the logo size and print position?

Send the selected model, artwork and preferred position. We show the proposed logo size and placement on a free product mockup before artwork approval.

What is the minimum order for a screen-printed logo?

One-colour logo: 250 pieces. Two-colour logo: 1,000 pieces. Three-colour logo: 2,000 pieces. Send your artwork or idea for a free design proposal and a product mockup.

Compare the Relevant Products and Service

Email Us for Free Design and a Project Quote
